elements.name: Kraul
elements.desc: The language of the Kraul, insectile humanoids of the Golgari Swarm. Uses its own script.

elements.name: Loxodon
elements.desc: The resonant, tonal language of the loxodons. Uses the Elvish script.

elements.name: Merfolk
elements.desc: The language of the merfolk, an aquatic people of Ravnica. Uses its own script.

elements.name: Minotaur
elements.desc: The language of Ravnican minotaurs. Uses its own script.

elements.name: Sphinx
elements.desc: The language of sphinxes. Has no written script.

elements.name: Vedalken
elements.desc: The language of the vedalken, precise and logical. Uses its own script.
